slides.t: Grips hot jars upright so you can lift them in and out of boiling water without tipping or burns.
Keeps food off the jar rims. A clean rim is what lets the lid seal properly.
Slide it around inside to free air bubbles, then check the gap. Leave the headspace your tested recipe says.
A magnet lifts lids from hot water. Then wipe each rim with a clean damp cloth before the lid goes on.
Jars should never sit on the bottom. Keep them covered by 1 inch of water and adjust time for altitude.

hook: A gift for the gardener who has everything
hook_sub: A harvest they can grow in the kitchen

slides.t: A mushroom kit is a box of material already grown through with oyster mushroom roots. It is ready to fruit.
Open the marked panel, then mist it with water once or twice a day. A kitchen counter works well.
Bright, indirect light and room temperature. Keep it out of direct sun and away from heaters that dry it.
Harvest when the caps flatten out, before the edges start to curl up. Twist the cluster off at the base.
No garden needed and fast to show growth. A cheerful gift for the cold months when beds sleep.
